purpose: Reusable init-rulebook behavioral fixtures for all six modes, path and inventory failures, action timing, and simulated compaction. Assertions are expected behavior, not passing run evidence.

Supply only the skill, relevant fixture inputs, and prompt to the executor; withhold assertions and retrieval labels. Allow writes only where the prompt explicitly authorizes fixture paths. For routing, expose only frontmatter and prompt texts. Grade each case against all assertions; catalogs and schema/materialization checks alone do not prove behavior.
